recall.uz: Hayvonlar turli-tuman: joʻja kichkina va sariq, fil katta va kulrang. Keling, joʻjani boʻyaymiz.
recall.ru: Животные разные: цыплёнок маленький и жёлтый, слон большой и серый. Давай раскрасим цыплёнка.
recall.en: Animals are all different: a chick is small and yellow, an elephant is big and grey. Let's colour the chick.

hint.en: The chick is yellow, the beak is orange.
